entry.note: Franecki-Kapranov constructible sheaves Riemann-Roch. No QOU citation site located on full-tree grep. Status: defer to author.

relevance.rationale: Join CORRECT (arXiv:math/9909088v1, Franecki-Kapranov, matching the registered entry's title, authors and URL). BIB ORPHAN: a full-tree grep for the key across content/ (.md, .lean, .ts) returns zero citation sites; the only hits anywhere are three docs/ mentions that themselves record it as uncited (docs/coordination/2026-05-19-bib-audit-summary.md:207 lists it as one of two uncited orphans; docs/workplans/2026-06-08-uploaded-paper-results-ingestion-backlog.md:59 records 'none'; docs/audits/2026-06-04-kontsevich-soibelman-0811.2435-qou-comparison.md:283 discusses its reference status). So its uncited state is already known and recorded - this triage confirms it rather than discovering it. The paper proves a noncompact Riemann-Roch formula for constructible sheaves on semiabelian varieties via a Gauss-map degree gdeg(Z), with the corollary that a perverse sheaf on such a group has non-negative Euler characteristic. A grep of content/ for 'perverse', 'constructible sheaf' and 'Gauss map' returns nothing, so there is currently no block that would consume it. Scope-(a): this document, as read, has no target in the present corpus; that is not a claim that microlocal/characteristic-cycle methods are irrelevant to the framework.

proposedActions.rationale: Registered, uncited, and with no block in the corpus that its results bear on. Leave the entry in place; re-triage if a characteristic-cycle or Euler-characteristic-positivity block is ever written.
